atAGlance: Gà kho gừng is chicken braised with ginger, usually with fish sauce, caramel color, pepper, and rice.
whatItIs: Gà kho gừng is chicken braised with ginger, pepper, fish sauce, and caramel until the meat turns warming and savory. It is made for spooning over rice.
howToEnjoy: Eat with rice so the ginger-pepper braising juices have somewhere to go. Add pickles or greens if they are served to cut the salt and sweetness.
howLocalsOrder: Order gà kho gừng as a rice-table dish. Ask for extra ginger if you like heat from ginger, or extra rice if the braise is strong.
worthKnowing: Gà kho gừng belongs to Vietnamese rice-table cooking, where ginger, pepper, and fish-sauce caramel turn simple chicken into something warming and savory.
goodToKnow: The heat comes from ginger and pepper as much as chili, so it can feel warming even when it is not fiery.
